name: UI Automation Inspector
purpose: Read the UI Automation accessible control tree of a target window (or the desktop): per-element control type, name, automation id, class, bounds, supported patterns, and state. Read-only — no actions.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Hwnd <int> | -ProcessId <int> | -Title <glob> (else the desktop root); -Depth <int> -MaxElements <int> -NameFilter <glob>. OR -InputsJson '<json {hwnd,pid,title,depth,max_elements,name_filter}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: pid
inputs.description: Target by process id (uses its main window).

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: Max tree depth from the target.

inputs.name: max_elements
inputs.description: Cap on elements; exceeding sets status=partial.

inputs.name: name_filter
inputs.description: Optional glob on element Name for a matches list.

outputs.description: { target, depth, element_count, truncated, name_filter, match_count, matches[], elements[] }
